reviews.text:
A disgrace to Japan. The shop knows the animals will be bought by hostesses and then abandoned, yet they still sell them.

A breeding ground for abandoned dogs and cats.

Here, animals are put up for sale in tiny shop windows right on a noisy main road. The animals struck me as clearly overwhelmed and apathetic. I found the conditions in these isolated, cramped, open-view sales pens to be extremely distressing and in no way appropriate for the animals’ welfare!
I find it appalling that animals are presented and marketed in this way, as if they were mere commodities, in this day and age. I consider this form of animal trade to be outdated and in urgent need of reform. In my view, the sale of animals under such conditions should be banned!

We met a cute puppy at this shop and welcomed it into our family. The staff provided excellent customer service, were incredibly kind throughout, and offered thorough after-sales support. Thank you so much!

We welcomed Arare, a Minuet pastel calico cat, into our home.

After bringing her home, the staff told us that she had been very well cared for while she was at the store, which made us incredibly happy. We had been a little worried that she might have been lonely before we brought her home, but knowing that she had been treated with such care put our minds at ease.

Now, she gets along well with our other cats and is growing up healthy and strong every day.

On the day we brought her home, the staff member's final words to Arare, "We love you," were very touching. It made us realize that they had not just taken care of her, but truly treated her with love.

We are so grateful that Arare grew up in such a warm environment. Thank you for this wonderful connection.

small cages with terrible conditions, scratch marks all along the toilet area out of boredom from the dogs. just feels evil, those poor dogs deserve better wish i could take them home but would just repeat the cycle
Selling animals in window shop should be ILLEGAL!!!

Selling such tiny animals at such a low price...

I can only see this as animal cruelty.

I visited the store the other night.

- Upon entering, the long-haired female staff member near the register did not greet me. She was continuously operating the computer at the register and did not say "welcome."

- Afterwards, the same staff member took out her smartphone and continued operating it while standing on one leg and holding it with one hand.

- Multiple piles of feces were left in the dog area on the first floor.

- Two of the dogs were actually eating their own feces.

- Although staff members were nearby, they did not seem to notice the feces or take any action.

- Finally, another staff member came down from the second floor, but started chatting before checking the situation.

- The feces remained there throughout my visit and were not cleaned up.

I was very surprised and disgusted by this staff member's attitude. I will never go there again.

POOR EXPERIENCE.  My dog just passed away today in the morning in the USA, I came to this store to grief my sorrows and I asked this lady who works there for a dog and if it’s vaccinated. She said if you don’t speak Japanese we can’t sell you a dog! She was so RUDE. I know that breaks the international laws of Japan and she should not work there and treat people with racism!

Please adopt, don’t shop. The puppies and kittens in this store are held in abusive conditions. It is extremely hot and their water bowls were barely filled. Many looked lethargic and depressed. Please look elsewhere and consider adoption. Places like this use puppy mills and similar methods of exploitation to turn profit. Extremely unethical. This place should be investigated and owners jailed.
The staff were very kind, which was great. We welcomed a Pomeranian into our home.
Sad place. Pets are kept in small glass boxes.

I was worried because the animals here seemed unwell.

They didn't react to humans, and they were unresponsive even when I picked them up.

Also, several of them were very thin, which worried me.
Lots of puppies and kittens of different breeds, all very fun and lively, I didn't see any depressed or in bad shape as some comments mention.
I just showed up unexpectedly 🐤 They don't sell birds, but they were so kind and helpful. There are no bad people among animal lovers. Thank you. I'm overwhelmed with gratitude. …

The air conditioning was too strong. It would make the puppies and kittens sick. They all looked depressed, the room was dirty, and it seemed like they weren't getting enough love, so I felt sorry for them. …
